Apple Watch health data sync (v1.0.0)

- Initial release for syncing Apple Watch health data to a PC using Health Auto Export.

- Includes platform-specific instructions for running the server as a background service.
- Provides detailed troubleshooting, verification, and fallback manual setup flow.
- Covers querying API, showing dashboards, and heartbeat health check integration for real-time monitoring.
- Emphasizes cross-platform compatibility (Windows/macOS/Linux) and requirements for both hardware and software.
